title: Windows Installation Troubleshooting
summary: Most Windows installation problems are caused by outdated installers, insufficient permissions, missing dependencies, or security software blocking setup.
steps: Download the latest installer from the official product source.
Run the installer as Administrator.
Verify that the system meets the minimum requirements.
Install any required runtime or dependency packages.
Temporarily test whether security software is blocking installation.
Review installer logs if the error continues.

title: API Authentication Troubleshooting
summary: API authentication errors commonly result from missing, expired, malformed, or incorrectly scoped credentials.
steps: Confirm the API key or access token is valid.
Verify the Authorization header format.
Check token expiration.
Confirm the credential has permission for the requested endpoint.
Check whether the API base URL and environment are correct.

title: Application Performance Troubleshooting
summary: Performance problems should be isolated by checking resource utilization, logs, network latency, application version, and workload size.
steps: Check CPU and memory utilization.
Review application logs for repeated warnings or exceptions.
Confirm the software is updated.
Test network latency when the product depends on remote services.
Reduce workload size temporarily to isolate scaling problems.

title: Configuration and Environment Issues
summary: Configuration problems often come from incorrect environment values, file paths, ports, permissions, or stale cached settings.
steps: Verify required environment variables.
Confirm configuration file paths.
Check port and host values.
Restart the application after changing configuration.
Compare the configuration with the supplied example file.

title: Password and Login Recovery
summary: Login problems can usually be resolved by verifying the account identifier, resetting the password, and checking whether the account is locked or disabled.
steps: Confirm the correct username or email address.
Use the official password-reset process.
Check whether Caps Lock or keyboard layout is affecting the password.
Verify that the account is active.
Contact an administrator if the account remains locked.
